mapper.select: SELECT * FROM borrow_limits ORDER BY user_type
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO borrow_limits (user_type, max_books, loan_days, renew_max_count, renew_days, pickup_days) VALUES (#{userType}, #{maxBooks}, #{loanDays}, #{renewMaxCount}, #{renewDays}, #{pickupDays}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE max_books = VALUES(max_books), loan_days = VALUES(loan_days), renew_max_count = VALUES(renew_max_count), renew_days = VALUES(renew_days), pickup_days = VALUES(pickup_days)
